definition: Dizziness is a sensation of spinning, unsteadiness, and spatial confusion. It can be brought on by bodily rotation, sudden head movement, motion such as being on a boat, heights, disturbances of the ear, or stomachic and toxic causes such as alcohol and other poisons, and it is distinguished from nausea, though the two may occur together.
